deployment.cache_invalidation: hostinger-hosting MCP hosting_clearWebsiteCacheV1 or query version bump (?v=vXX)

invariants.name: Custom Trail Pack
invariants.options: Choose Cocoa Percentage (50%, 70%, 100%), Select Flavor 1 through 6
invariants.rules: Trail Packs have flat ₹540 pricing; MUST NEVER fall into the single-tablet sweetener formula. Must skip custom-wa-notice-group in modal loops.

invariants.name: Custom WhatsApp Notice Banner
invariants.rules: Banner in custom product modals does NOT have .modal-option-label. Any loop over .modal-option-group MUST check if (group.classList.contains('custom-wa-notice-group')) return; and check if (!labelEl) return; to avoid null pointer exceptions.

invariants.name: 100% Dark Tablets Monk Sweetener
invariants.rules: In 100% Dark mode, Monk Sweetener can be toggled on or off without forcing auto-select, keeping base tablet price.

invariants.name: Cavities Pricing
invariants.rules: Cavities pricing is dynamic based on sweetener: standard ₹25, Coconut Sugar ₹35, Monk Fruit ₹45.

history.issue: Custom Trail Pack add to cart crashed due to null .modal-option-label on custom-wa-notice-group
history.resolution: Added defensive checks in pages.js and assigned dedicated trail pack flat pricing (₹540). Bumped version to v81.
